# Version 4.153.0
> **Skia m153 update** · [NuGet (prerelease)](https://www.nuget.org/packages/SkiaSharp/4.153.0-rc.1.26456.2)

> **API changes** · [SkiaSharp API diff](4.153.0/index.md) · [HarfBuzzSharp API diff](harfbuzzsharp/14.2.1.300/index.md)

## Highlights

SkiaSharp 4.153.0 advances to the Skia m153 renderer with its upstream correctness fixes. Linux applications relying on implicit font fallback should review the changed fontconfig selection behavior before upgrading.

## Breaking Changes

- **Linux font fallback can select a different face** — Skia now tries FcFontMatch before the previous FcFontSort fallback path, so applications that rely on the exact fallback face can see different glyphs or text metrics. Specify an explicit family and style, or use a bundled typeface, when deterministic selection matters.

## Engine

- **Skia updated to milestone m153** — Updates the bundled renderer to Chrome milestone 153 and incorporates its upstream correctness and buffer-upload fixes. ([#4826](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4826), [#4927](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4927), [#5062](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5062), [#5116](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5116))
